survivor_shortcuts.affordance: every interference link connects a device of one type to a device of the other

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It constructs global color groups rather than correctly choosing the better side independently in every connected component, so disconnected components with opposite color orientations can make its reported maximum too small.
Its approach similarly treats the bipartition as two global groups, which is insufficient when the optimal independent set uses different sides in different connected components.
It uses global bipartition sets instead of combining the larger color side separately for each connected component, causing false NO answers on disconnected bipartite graphs.

recommended_edit: No edit can defeat the surviving approach while preserving the task: the bipartite guarantee is the core structural property. The only decisive edit would be to remove the two-type promise and make the input an arbitrary graph, which changes the problem.
